Class Figure

java.lang.Object
chess.figures.Figure
All Implemented Interfaces:
IntFigure
Direct Known Subclasses:
Knight, Pawn, Rook
public abstract class Figure extends Object implements IntFigure
Figure.java Abstract superclass that stores shared piece attributes and implements IntFigure without providing movement behavior.

  • Constructor Details

    • Figure

      public Figure(ChessPieceType pieceName, ChessColor color, LocationX column, int row)
      Creates a Figure object using the supplied piece type, color, column, and row.
      Parameters:
      pieceName - chess piece type stored in the object.
      color - piece color as a ChessColor value.
      column - column of the position as a LocationX value.
      row - row number of the position.
      Throws:
      InvalidPieceException - piece type is null.
      IllegalArgumentException - color is null.
      InvalidCoordinateException - starting coordinates are invalid.
